title: Bible of Kralice (Bible kralická, 1579-1593; 1613 edition text), full Bible, one verse per line
period: 16th century (1579-1593), Middle/early-modern Czech; replaces the 19th-c. period-mismatched Czech pin with a much larger and older text
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/cs/CzeBKR/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module CzeBKR). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,106,471 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'czech') gives 3,363,852 characters. Czech is in refcorpus.KNOWN, so diacritics fold to a-z. An earlier Czech submission under the bare M-J step was overwritten and is not pinned; this is the corrected, separate submission.
